summary.title: Tricentis SeaLights: Test what matters with quality intelligence
summary.one_liner: Tricentis SeaLights is a quality intelligence product that maps code changes to the tests covering them, so teams can run fewer tests and spot untested code before release.
keywords: which tests to run after code change
takeaways: SeaLights maps each code change in a build to the tests that cover it, using a build scanner and test listener.
Test Impact Analytics recommends which tests to run and which to skip, aiming to cut regression scope.
Test Gap Analysis and User Story Coverage surface untested code and link gaps to business functionality.
SeaLights for ABAP maps SAP transports to tests and supports SAP ECC and S/4HANA, integrating with tools such as Tosca, qTest and Xray.

The page lists languages covered (Java, Node.js, TypeScript, Go, Python, C#, .NET and others) and cites vendor-reported results such as an 88% CI cycle time reduction and 70% regression scope reduction.
summary.summary: This is a product landing page for Tricentis SeaLights, a quality intelligence tool, rather than an article about technical debt despite the URL slug. It describes how the tool integrates into CI/CD pipelines, captures code changes and test executions, and produces coverage maps, test gap reports, and test recommendations. It also covers a separate SAP-focused offering (SeaLights for ABAP) and lists vendor-cited statistics, including customer case results, which are unverified marketing claims. The page includes little technical detail on implementation, so the information is mostly feature overview.
